question.problem:
$$
f(x)∼\frac{{a}_{0}}{2}+{\sum }_{n=1}^{\infty }{a}_{n}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{8}x)+{b}_{n}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{n\pi }{8}x)
$$

Let $F(x)=-x+5$ for $x\in [-8,8).$ The Fourier series of the $16$-periodic extension $f(x)$ of $F(x)$ is shown above. Find the exact value of ${a}_{0}.$

${a}_{0}=$ {{field-1}}
question.worked_solution:
For the Fourier series of a $2L$-periodic function, the constant term is given by

$$
{a}_{0}=\frac{1}{L}{\int }_{-L}^{L}f(x)\,\text{d}x.
$$

In our case, $L=8$ and $f(x)=-x+5$ for $x\in [-8,8).$ So, substituting into the formula, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{0} & =\frac{1}{8}{\int }_{-8}^{8}(-x+5)\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{8}{[-\frac{1}{2}{x}^{2}+5x]}_{-8}^{8} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}((-\frac{1}{2}\cdot {8}^{2}+5\cdot 8)-(-\frac{1}{2}\cdot (-8)^{2}+5\cdot (-8))) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}(8-(-72)) \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$
